what: The day's line draws itself on black, macro
Cut wide on the drop; the four answers roll in
The line lands at 7:42 PM; the reading swells into its ring
Four weeks fill the pattern on the grid
The busiest hour is marked; Every week, a rhythm.
Activity log, one beat long; the rail holds the frame
The real Arabic render; the rail has crossed the frame
Laptop and phone land on the biggest lift
The one held frame; Now, read yours.
Drafting lines build the mark around the reading
The white mark and FITWAY; the poster frame
